import sympy as s
I=s.I;X=s.Matrix([[0,1],[1,0]]);Y=s.Matrix([[0,-I],[I,0]]);Z=s.diag(1,-1)
b=[Z,Y,X]
def coords(m): return s.Matrix([s.trace(c*m)/2 for c in b]).applyfunc(s.simplify)
L=s.Matrix.hstack(*(coords(I*(Z*c-c*Z)) for c in b));H=s.Matrix.hstack(*(coords(I*(c*3*Z-3*Z*c)) for c in b))
P=L.T*L+H.T*H;D=L-I*H
print({'P':str(P),'raw_D_adjoint_D':str(D.H*D),'raw_structural_equality':P==D.H*D,'expanded_residual':str((P-D.H*D).applyfunc(s.expand)),'target_unchanged':P==s.diag(0,40,40)})
